scope: Add the current LibreCAD branch-head per-version DWG readiness matrix to the existing migration source-overlay review, preserve the evidence boundary between dispatch and tested behavior, and verify the GDAL CAD/libopencad lineage without expanding the per-slice validation loop.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source web research and local plan cross-check
localInspection: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: existing pinned LibreCAD source-overlay, version/operation evidence, comparator, and fast-loop gates
DWG_DXF_3D_SUPPORT_PLAN.md: existing versioned 3D carrier/semantic and external consumer qualification boundaries
metadata/qualified-format-claims-v1.json and metadata/qualified-format-status-v1.json: local claim/evidence authority is independent of peer inventories
method.limitations: LibreCAD master and GDAL stable documentation are mutable pages; no immutable LibreCAD commit, GDAL build, or embedded libopencad revision was established or executed. Generated inventory statements are treated only as source/readiness metadata.

evidence.topic: LibreCAD per-version readiness is distinct from its entity/callback census
evidence.observed: The current LibreCAD DWG_VERSION_SUPPORT_STATUS.md is generated from the version and dispatch sources. It identifies AC code/release family, reader and writer entrypoints, target/current level, dispatch diagnostic, positive/negative fixture IDs, blockers, and promotion gates. The report calls itself static readiness information; rows with dispatch entrypoints still mark positive and negative fixture evidence blocked, and writer rows require an external writer smoke in addition to local matrix evidence. The separate DWG_DXF_COVERAGE_INVENTORY.md calls itself deterministic source inventory rather than byte-level conformance.
doesNotEstablish: successful parsing or writing of any exact input/output
semantic fidelity, reference closure, independent acceptance, or native CAD behavior
a stable upstream target snapshot, since the pages were not pinned to an immutable commit
evidence.planUse: At the existing pinned source-overlay checkpoint, compare the version matrix by exact AC code, operation, reader/writer path, readiness level, and evidence blocker. Keep it non-authoritative and separate from the feature/name inventory and local qualified support ledger.

evidence.topic: GDAL CAD and libopencad are one parser lineage
evidence.observed: GDAL's official CAD driver documentation says the DWG route is provided by internal libopencad. The current NextGIS libopencad README advertises DWG R2000 only. GDAL OGR output is a consumer projection and does not create a second underlying DWG parser observation when compared with direct libopencad output.
doesNotEstablish: AC1015 completeness, DXF/DWG writing, modern DWG support, or full object-graph fidelity
an independent parser vote between GDAL CAD and direct libopencad
evidence.planUse: Retain the already-listed optional AC1015/common-geometry comparator only; record the selected GDAL driver and embedded implementation identity, and do not add a dependency or acceptance gate.

readinessRefinement: pin and compare the migration target's version status and entity/callback inventories as separate generated source artifacts
treat dispatch, static entrypoints, fixture-backed behavior, independent-reader results, and native acceptance as distinct statuses
do not count GDAL CAD and direct libopencad as independent parser lineages
keep inventory generation at the composed source-overlay checkpoint rather than adding per-slice test work
